# radar/radar.asm: Radar strip in the bottom panel

Range `$5260-$529D`. Source: [radar/radar.asm](../../../../src/radar/radar.asm). Index: [the reference](../../index.md).

## Names

<a id="radar_put_chars"></a>
### [`radar_put_chars`](../../../../src/radar/radar.asm#L6) `$5260`

*routine*

Puts the radar characters at column 12: $d0-$df on row 21 and $e0-$ef on row 22 with colour 9. $f0-$ff go on row 23 with colour 7.

- **Called from:** [`$4159`](../../../../src/game/main_loop.asm#L18)
- **Reads:** [`colour_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#colour_ptr), [`scroll_colour_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#scroll_colour_ptr)
- **Writes:** [`colour_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#colour_ptr), [`scroll_colour_ptr`](../../memory-map.md#scroll_colour_ptr), [`colour_ptr_hi`](../../memory-map.md#colour_ptr_hi), [`scroll_colour_ptr_hi`](../../memory-map.md#scroll_colour_ptr_hi)
